summary: Build crisis scenarios, model exposure, and strengthen executive reporting with practical tools. Enrol in this 5-day course today.
lede: Crisis risk assessment and modeling helps resilience, risk, and continuity professionals identify, score, and prioritize potential crisis scenarios. Participants practice building scenario libraries, calibrating likelihood and impact, estimating exposure, and using heat maps, Bowtie analysis, and stress tests to examine barriers and dependencies. They also map triggers to escalation pathways and prepare registers, dashboards, and leadership briefs to support response decisions when information and time are limited.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, model, escalate, and report crisis risks across operations, resilience, compliance, and governance functions.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of organizational risk processes, incident response, or business continuity planning. Familiarity with basic risk assessment concepts, spreadsheet use, and internal reporting is helpful. No coding is required, although experience with dashboards, incident logs, or risk registers will help you move faster through the exercises.
